mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals active monetary easing that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0% in a 3-month rolling window, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in consumer credit (RSAFS) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates coordinated monetary and credit easing that boosts consumer spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The RSAFS decline/FEDFUNDS decline interaction fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals imminent economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of INDPRO decline instances during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over 6 months indicates labor market strength that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 100k jobs monthly.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1,200.0 thousand units in a 3-month average, it signals housing sector contraction that reduces consumer wealth and business investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is below 1,200.0.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of UNRATE > 4.5% and FEDFUNDS < 4.5% indicates central bank response to labor market deterioration, which precedes recession and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market deterioration with monetary easing
failure_condition: The UNRATE>4.5%/FEDFUNDS<4.5% interaction fails to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.0% annually signals persistent inflation that forces Fed rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% during tightening cycles.
